<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

This report creates the sole stage-specific data entry for Step 5. It preserves
the complete 90-occasion prompt scaffold, creates the prespecified 12 nodes in three
communities, fixes the common theory-based network layout, and audits the exact
rows and lag-1 transitions available to the primary mlVAR. It estimates no
network model.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  collapse = FALSE, comment = NA
)

required_packages <- c("dplyr", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "tibble", "tidyr")
available <- vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
if (!all(available)) {
  stop("Missing required R packages: ", paste(names(available)[!available], collapse = ", "))
}

locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  # Public code folders remain available even when private data/docs are absent.
  markers <- c("Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability", "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis")
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (length(current) != 1L) stop("Supply one project location")
  if (!dir.exists(current)) current <- dirname(current)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(current, markers)))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not locate the public analysis project from: ", start)
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop("Expected only ", expected_name, "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", "))
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}

strict_complete_mean <- function(data, variables) {
  values <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[variables], as.numeric))
  complete <- rowSums(!is.na(values)) == length(variables)
  score <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(values))
  score[complete] <- rowMeans(values[complete, , drop = FALSE])
  score
}

safe_mean <- function(x) if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

zero_within_person <- function(x, id) {
  by_person <- split(x, id)
  sum(vapply(by_person, function(values) {
    values <- values[is.finite(values)]
    length(values) > 1L && stats::sd(values) == 0
  }, logical(1)))
}

report_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
project_root <- locate_project_root(
  if (length(report_file) == 1L && file.exists(report_file)) report_file else getwd()
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

input_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "dat_focal_analysis.rda"
)
output_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "dat_step5_mlvar.rda"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(input_file))
dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Nodes, communities, and initial layout

The primary network contains exactly three Engagement Time nodes, six PSMU
manifestation nodes, and three Distress-domain nodes. Peripheral and Core are
subgroups inside the one PSMU community, not additional communities. The
coordinate matrix below is fixed before model results are viewed and is reused
unchanged for all three networks.

```{r node-map}
node_map <- data.frame(
  order = 1:12,
  node = c(
    "InteractiveLog", "ActiveLog", "PassiveLog",
    paste0("PMU", 1:6),
    "DepressiveAffect", "Anxiety", "Stress"
  ),
  label = c(
    "Interactive Time", "Active Time", "Passive Time",
    "Salience", "Tolerance", "Mood Modification",
    "Relapse", "Withdrawal", "Conflict",
    "Depressive Affect", "Anxiety", "Stress"
  ),
  short_label = c(
    "Interactive", "Active", "Passive",
    "Salience", "Tolerance", "Mood mod.",
    "Relapse", "Withdrawal", "Conflict",
    "Depressive", "Anxiety", "Stress"
  ),
  community = c(
    rep("Engagement Time", 3), rep("PSMU", 6), rep("Distress", 3)
  ),
  subgroup = c(
    rep(NA_character_, 3), rep("Peripheral", 2), rep("Core", 4),
    rep(NA_character_, 3)
  ),
  source = c(
    "log1p(mu_time1)", "log1p(mu_time2)", "log1p(mu_time3)",
    paste0("PMU", 1:6),
    "mean(DASS5,DASS6)", "mean(DASS3,DASS4)", "mean(DASS1,DASS2)"
  ),
  scoring = c(
    rep("log1p raw duration minutes", 3),
    rep("Observed 1-5 EMA manifestation item", 6),
    rep("Strict-complete mean of two 1-5 EMA items", 3)
  ),
  node_fill = c(rep("#F3C677", 3), rep("#9E77ED", 6), rep("#6BCB77", 3)),
  node_border = c(
    rep("#A66A00", 3), rep("#F39C12", 2), rep("#5B2C6F", 4),
    rep("#237A32", 3)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

network_layout <- data.frame(
  node = node_map$node,
  x = c(-1.80, -1.80, -1.80, -0.55, 0.35, 0.80, 0.75, 0.05, -0.70, 1.80, 1.80, 1.80),
  y = c(0.95, 0.00, -0.95, 1.20, 1.20, 0.45, -0.40, -1.15, -0.45, 0.95, 0.00, -0.95),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(node_map) == 12L,
  !anyDuplicated(node_map$node),
  identical(unique(node_map$community), c("Engagement Time", "PSMU", "Distress")),
  identical(network_layout$node, node_map$node),
  !anyNA(network_layout[c("x", "y")])
)

knitr::kable(node_map[c("order", "node", "label", "community", "subgroup", "source")])
```

# Load and validate the canonical prompt scaffold

```{r load-source}
dat_focal_analysis <- load_single_object(input_file, "dat_focal_analysis")

id_variables <- c("Data_ID", "Name_ID", "Day", "Time")
duration_variables <- paste0("mu_time", 1:3)
pmu_variables <- paste0("PMU", 1:6)
dass_variables <- paste0("DASS", 1:6)
required_variables <- c(
  id_variables, duration_variables, pmu_variables, dass_variables
)

missing_variables <- setdiff(required_variables, names(dat_focal_analysis))
if (length(missing_variables)) {
  stop("Missing required variables: ", paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", "))
}

prompt_counts <- table(dat_focal_analysis$Name_ID)
day_counts <- tapply(
  dat_focal_analysis$Day, dat_focal_analysis$Name_ID, dplyr::n_distinct
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(dat_focal_analysis) == 18810L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(dat_focal_analysis$Name_ID) == 209L,
  !anyNA(dat_focal_analysis[id_variables]),
  !anyDuplicated(dat_focal_analysis[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")]),
  !anyDuplicated(dat_focal_analysis$Data_ID),
  identical(sort(unique(dat_focal_analysis$Day)), 1:30),
  identical(sort(unique(dat_focal_analysis$Time)), 1:3),
  all(prompt_counts == 90L),
  all(day_counts == 30L),
  all(vapply(dat_focal_analysis[duration_variables], function(x) {
    all(is.na(x) | (x >= 0 & x <= 300))
  }, logical(1))),
  all(vapply(dat_focal_analysis[c(pmu_variables, dass_variables)], function(x) {
    all(is.na(x) | x %in% 1:5)
  }, logical(1)))
)

source_audit <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "Scheduled rows", "Participants", "Prompts per participant",
    "Days per participant", "Duplicate prompt keys", "Duplicate Data_ID"
  ),
  observed = c(
    nrow(dat_focal_analysis), dplyr::n_distinct(dat_focal_analysis$Name_ID),
    paste(range(prompt_counts), collapse = "-"),
    paste(range(day_counts), collapse = "-"),
    sum(duplicated(dat_focal_analysis[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")])),
    sum(duplicated(dat_focal_analysis$Data_ID))
  ),
  expected = c("18810", "209", "90", "30", "0", "0"),
  passed = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(source_audit)
```

# Construct the 12-node prompt data

```{r construct-prompt}
prompt <- dat_focal_analysis |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, Day, Time) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Data_ID = as.numeric(Data_ID),
    Name_ID = as.numeric(Name_ID),
    Day = as.integer(Day),
    Time = as.integer(Time),
    occasion = as.integer(3L * (Day - 1L) + Time),
    InteractiveMinutes = as.numeric(mu_time1),
    ActiveMinutes = as.numeric(mu_time2),
    PassiveMinutes = as.numeric(mu_time3),
    InteractiveLog = log1p(InteractiveMinutes),
    ActiveLog = log1p(ActiveMinutes),
    PassiveLog = log1p(PassiveMinutes),
    PMU1 = as.numeric(PMU1), PMU2 = as.numeric(PMU2),
    PMU3 = as.numeric(PMU3), PMU4 = as.numeric(PMU4),
    PMU5 = as.numeric(PMU5), PMU6 = as.numeric(PMU6),
    DepressiveAffect = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(DASS5, DASS6), c("DASS5", "DASS6")
    ),
    Anxiety = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(DASS3, DASS4), c("DASS3", "DASS4")
    ),
    Stress = strict_complete_mean(
      dplyr::pick(DASS1, DASS2), c("DASS1", "DASS2")
    )
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

node_names <- node_map$node
prompt$node_complete <- stats::complete.cases(prompt[node_names])
prompt$prior_node_complete <- ave(
  prompt$node_complete, prompt$Name_ID,
  FUN = function(x) c(FALSE, head(x, -1L))
)
prompt$prior_occasion <- ave(
  prompt$occasion, prompt$Name_ID,
  FUN = function(x) c(NA_integer_, head(x, -1L))
)
prompt$prior_day <- ave(
  prompt$Day, prompt$Name_ID,
  FUN = function(x) c(NA_integer_, head(x, -1L))
)
prompt$consecutive <- !is.na(prompt$prior_occasion) &
  prompt$occasion - prompt$prior_occasion == 1L
prompt$lag1_complete <- prompt$node_complete & prompt$prior_node_complete &
  prompt$consecutive
prompt$transition_type <- ifelse(
  !prompt$consecutive, NA_character_,
  ifelse(prompt$Day == prompt$prior_day, "Within-day", "Overnight")
)

sequence_audit <- prompt |>
  dplyr::group_by(Name_ID) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    rows = dplyr::n(), min_occasion = min(occasion), max_occasion = max(occasion),
    exact_sequence = identical(occasion, 1:90), .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(sequence_audit) == 209L,
  all(sequence_audit$rows == 90L),
  all(sequence_audit$min_occasion == 1L),
  all(sequence_audit$max_occasion == 90L),
  all(sequence_audit$exact_sequence),
  sum(prompt$node_complete) == 17755L,
  sum(prompt$lag1_complete) == 16598L,
  sum(prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Within-day") == 11125L,
  sum(prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Overnight") == 5473L
)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  scheduled_rows = nrow(prompt),
  complete_12_node_occasions = sum(prompt$node_complete),
  possible_primary_transitions = sum(prompt$consecutive),
  usable_primary_transitions = sum(prompt$lag1_complete),
  usable_within_day_transitions = sum(
    prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Within-day"
  ),
  usable_overnight_transitions = sum(
    prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Overnight"
  )
))
```

# Scaling, variance, and correlation diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
scaling <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(node_names, function(variable) {
  values <- prompt[[variable]]
  person_mean <- ave(values, prompt$Name_ID, FUN = safe_mean)
  within <- values - person_mean
  person_values <- tapply(values, prompt$Name_ID, safe_mean)
  data.frame(
    node = variable,
    observed = as.integer(sum(!is.na(values))),
    missing = as.integer(sum(is.na(values))),
    mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_sd = stats::sd(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    pooled_within_sd = stats::sd(within, na.rm = TRUE),
    between_sd_person_means = stats::sd(person_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_within_persons = as.integer(zero_within_person(values, prompt$Name_ID)),
    minimum = min(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(values, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

distress_nodes <- c("DepressiveAffect", "Anxiety", "Stress")
distress_within <- as.data.frame(lapply(distress_nodes, function(variable) {
  prompt[[variable]] - ave(prompt[[variable]], prompt$Name_ID, FUN = safe_mean)
}))
names(distress_within) <- distress_nodes
distress_person <- aggregate(
  prompt[distress_nodes], list(Name_ID = prompt$Name_ID), safe_mean
)

distress_within_correlation <- stats::cor(
  distress_within, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)
distress_between_correlation <- stats::cor(
  distress_person[distress_nodes], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

upper_values <- function(matrix) as.numeric(matrix[upper.tri(matrix)])

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(scaling$total_sd)),
  all(scaling$total_sd > 0),
  range(upper_values(distress_within_correlation))[[1L]] > 0.45,
  range(upper_values(distress_within_correlation))[[2L]] < 0.67,
  range(upper_values(distress_between_correlation))[[1L]] > 0.80,
  range(upper_values(distress_between_correlation))[[2L]] < 0.93
)

knitr::kable(scaling, digits = 4)
knitr::kable(round(distress_within_correlation, 3), caption = "Within-person Distress-domain correlations")
knitr::kable(round(distress_between_correlation, 3), caption = "Between-person Distress-domain correlations")
```

# Save and disk-reload the canonical Step 5 entry

```{r save-and-validate}
sample_audit <- data.frame(
  sample = c(
    "Scheduled scaffold", "Complete 12-node occasions",
    "Possible lag-1 transitions", "Usable lag-1 transitions",
    "Usable within-day transitions", "Usable overnight transitions"
  ),
  rows_or_transitions = as.integer(c(
    nrow(prompt), sum(prompt$node_complete), sum(prompt$consecutive),
    sum(prompt$lag1_complete),
    sum(prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Within-day"),
    sum(prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Overnight")
  )),
  participants = c(
    209L, dplyr::n_distinct(prompt$Name_ID[prompt$node_complete]),
    209L, dplyr::n_distinct(prompt$Name_ID[prompt$lag1_complete]),
    dplyr::n_distinct(prompt$Name_ID[
      prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Within-day"
    ]),
    dplyr::n_distinct(prompt$Name_ID[
      prompt$lag1_complete & prompt$transition_type == "Overnight"
    ])
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

provenance <- list(
  source_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_focal_analysis.rda",
  source_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_file)),
  generating_script = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_1_PreparemlVARData.Rmd",
  created = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  r_version = R.version.string,
  primary_model = paste(
    "12-node mlVAR; lmer; lag 1; orthogonal temporal and contemporaneous",
    "random effects; scale=TRUE; scaleWithin=FALSE; global occasion beep",
    sep = "; "
  ),
  missing_rule = paste(
    "Preserve 90 scheduled rows; mlVAR na.rm=TRUE uses complete augmented",
    "current-plus-lag rows and never bridges a missing prompt"
  ),
  overnight_rule = "Primary model retains overnight transitions; no exclusion sensitivity planned",
  final_export_rule = "No CSV; downstream Excel via bruceR::export and SVG via ggplot2::ggsave"
)

dat_step5_mlvar <- list(
  prompt = prompt,
  node_map = node_map,
  layout = network_layout,
  scaling = scaling,
  sample_audit = sample_audit,
  diagnostics = list(
    source = source_audit,
    sequence = sequence_audit,
    distress_within_correlation = distress_within_correlation,
    distress_between_correlation = distress_between_correlation
  ),
  provenance = provenance
)

save(dat_step5_mlvar, file = output_file, version = 2)
rm(dat_step5_mlvar)
dat_step5_mlvar <- load_single_object(output_file, "dat_step5_mlvar")

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(dat_step5_mlvar),
    c("prompt", "node_map", "layout", "scaling", "sample_audit", "diagnostics", "provenance")
  ),
  nrow(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt) == 18810L,
  nrow(dat_step5_mlvar$node_map) == 12L,
  identical(dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$node, node_names),
  sum(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt$lag1_complete) == 16598L,
  identical(
    dat_step5_mlvar$provenance$overnight_rule,
    "Primary model retains overnight transitions; no exclusion sensitivity planned"
  )
)

output_audit <- data.frame(
  output = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step5_mlvar.rda",
  object = "dat_step5_mlvar",
  bytes = file.info(output_file)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(output_file)),
  reload_passed = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(sample_audit)
knitr::kable(output_audit)
```
